name: multiplexer_sessions
description: the sessions the multiplexer holds, with what each one holds right now

name: multiplexer_records
description: the records of one session, from a number onwards; the log is the record

name: multiplexer_send
description: send text to the shell of one session; it changes what the session does, so it needs the human's token

name: multiplexer_control
description: drive the multiplexer as the owner does: the words of the command line — tab new, pane new, scroll up, copy PANE FIRST LAST, paste PANE — run on the owner's own screen; it changes what the session does, so it needs the human's token

name: multiplexer_view
description: what the owner's screen shows right now: the tabs, the panes with their text and their scroll, the focus and the ring of copies; a read is free
